title: A unit orientation of a subspace has operator norm at most 1
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, let Q be a linear subspace of ℝ^P (Euclid P), and let ξ ∈ Λ_n(ℝ^P) = MultiVector P n, i.e. a continuous linear functional on the normed space Covector (Euclid P) n of continuous alternating n-linear forms on ℝ^P (operator norms throughout). If ξ is a unit orientation of Q (IsUnitOrientationOf ξ Q: there is an orthonormal family τ = (τ_1,…,τ_n) in ℝ^P spanning Q such that ξ(α) = α(τ_1,…,τ_n) for every n-covector α, or ξ(α) = −α(τ_1,…,τ_n) for every n-covector α), then ‖ξ‖ ≤ 1.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (ξ : MultiVector P n), IsUnitOrientationOf ξ Q → ‖ξ‖ ≤ 1
